abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Echoes of the Damned
abilities.description: Entities that die near Renna have a chance of leaving behind their Essence that can be consumed by moving nearby. Heroes always leave behind Essence. Essence enhances Renna's abilities directly. If Renna Jumps while mid-air, she will begin to hover, falling slowly.

abilities.name: Mortal Coil
abilities.description: Launch a Soul Orb that deploys upon contact with a Hero or the World. Once deployed, the Soul Orb attacks nearby Enemy Targets, pulling them in and dealing 70.0/100.0/130.0/160.0/190.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage over 4s. Enemies that take damage from Soul Orb while below 6% (+1% per 30 Essence) health are executed. Renna is healed for 16.0/18.0/20.0/22.0/24.0% of her damage dealt to Targets attached to the Soul Orb. Healing is 8% effective against Minions and Monsters. The radius is increased by 1% per 10 Essence.

abilities.name: Stupor
abilities.description: Renna shifts upwards and prepares to launch a ball of demonic energy. Upon re-activating or after 1.5s, Renna will launch the orb that explodes on contact dealing 70.0/95.0/120.0/145.0/170.0 (+50% magical power) damage and mesmerizing Targets hit for 1.0/1.1/1.1/1.1/1.2s. Deals an additional 1% of the Target's Current Health as Magical Damage per 30 Essence.

abilities.name: Soulfire
abilities.description: Swing your weapon to fire 3 piercing projectile waves over 1.5s that each deal 50.0/57.0/64.0/71.0/78.0 (+21% magical power) damage. Swings faster to create an additional projectile within the same duration per 50 Essence.

abilities.name: Abyssal Rift
abilities.description: After a 1.5s channel, Renna teleports to the Target location and summons an infernal singularity above herself for 5s that unleashes projectiles every 0.5s at nearby Targets that deal 60.0/82.0/104.0 (+25% magical power) magical damage. Lasts 0.5s longer per 50 Essence.

augments.name: Communion
augments.description: Mortal Coil no longer Executes but has 20% increased Radius. Ally Heroes now heal themselves upon damaging targets in its area, at 100% effectiveness.

augments.name: Netherward
augments.description: Upon using Soulfire, gain a 40 (+40% magical power) Shield for 2s.

augments.name: Vital Essence
augments.description: Picking up Essence grants +4 gold and restores 3.5% Missing Health and Mana.
